title: Hollow and Crown
premise: Emrys Oyelaran, a debt-bound scribe in the Ledger Guild of Vhalen, discovers that the guild's 'impossible things' are fragments of a country called Serevan, which was erased from the world decades ago — and that its people survive only as memories traded like coin. When a child arrives speaking pre-kingdom Serevani and calling Emrys by a name they've never used, Emrys learns they were born inside Serevan before the erasure, their past sold to pay their debts. Hunted by the guild's enforcers and shadowed by the Hollow King, the erased nation's grief-mad remnant, Emrys must gather the scattered memory-fragments and find the Last Door out of a country that no longer exists. In the end, Emrys chooses to reopen the Door and let winter fall on the guild instead, restoring Serevan's people to the world at the cost of their own remembered name — surviving, finally, as someone new.
about_author: Oscar Hartwell is the pen name of a former archivist who spent a decade cataloguing documents belonging to institutions that no longer exist. They write fantasy about paperwork, grief, and the stubborn arithmetic of staying alive.

chapters.title: The Weight of Ink
chapters.summary: Emrys's POV. A day in the Ledger Guild: copying inventories of impossible things — bottled laughter, a key to nowhere, a jar of last words. Establishes Emrys's crushing debt and careful, watchful nature. Emotional beat: quiet resignation masking hunger for something more.

chapters.title: A Child at the Threshold
chapters.summary: Emrys's POV. During a snowstorm, a child appears at the guild's door speaking a language no living tongue should know — and calls Emrys by the name 'Sef.' The guild elders react with fear, not wonder. Emotional beat: uncanny recognition Emrys cannot explain.

chapters.title: Entries in a Dead Hand
chapters.summary: Emrys's POV, with ledger excerpts. Emrys finds old entries in their own handwriting they never wrote, dated before their birth. First hint of sold memories. Emotional beat: vertigo of self-doubt.

chapters.title: The Guild's Kind Arithmetic
chapters.summary: Guildmaster Corvane's POV. Corvane reviews Emrys's file and orders the child detained, revealing the guild trades in extracted memories of the erased country Serevan. Emotional beat: cold institutional menace.

chapters.title: What the Child Remembers
chapters.summary: Emrys's POV. In secret, Emrys speaks with the child, Iri, who describes Serevan's orchards and bells — and insists Emrys was there. Emotional beat: longing for a home Emrys never knew.

chapters.title: The Price of Staying
chapters.summary: Emrys's POV. Corvane offers to forgive Emrys's debt if they help extract Iri's memories for sale. Emotional beat: temptation versus protectiveness; Emrys stalls.

chapters.title: The Extraction Room
chapters.summary: Iri's POV. Iri witnesses another debtor's memory being drawn out into a vial — a man forgetting his daughter's face mid-sentence. Emotional beat: terror made bureaucratic.

chapters.title: Running on Borrowed Names
chapters.summary: Emrys's POV. Emrys steals Iri's ledger page and flees the guild through the flooded undercity. Emotional beat: exhilaration curdling into fear of pursuit.

chapters.title: The Hollow King's Winter
chapters.summary: Antagonist POV. The Hollow King — Serevan's last sovereign, sustained by hoarded grief — feels the theft of Iri's page and sends his Silent Court after it. Emotional beat: sorrow weaponized.

chapters.title: A Market of Forgotten Things
chapters.summary: Emrys's POV. Emrys and Iri reach the Nightmarket, where memory-fragments are bought and sold, and meet Vesha, a fence who deals in Serevani goods. Emotional beat: wary alliance.

chapters.title: Vesha's Ledger
chapters.summary: Vesha's POV. Vesha recognizes Emrys's face from a fragment she owns — a memory of Serevan's burning. She agrees to help, for a price. Emotional beat: guilt and opportunism entwined.

chapters.title: The Fragment That Bites
chapters.summary: Emrys's POV. Touching a fragment floods Emrys with a true memory: standing in Serevan's archive as the erasure began. Emotional beat: grief arriving all at once, unearned and undeniable.

chapters.title: Silent Court
chapters.summary: Emrys's POV. The Hollow King's agents ambush them at Vesha's; Vesha is taken, Emrys and Iri escape into the catacombs. Emotional beat: survivor's shame.

chapters.title: Catacombs of the Unwritten
chapters.summary: Iri's POV. Lost underground, Iri reveals the catacombs are Serevan's unburied dead — names carved by those who foresaw the erasure. Emotional beat: solemn awe.

chapters.title: Corvane's Offer, Repeated
chapters.summary: Corvane's POV. Corvane tracks Emrys not to punish but to recruit: the guild needs someone born of Serevan to open the Last Door and harvest what's inside. Emotional beat: patient, paternal menace.

chapters.title: The Map That Eats Itself
chapters.summary: Emrys's POV. Using guild cartography stolen earlier, Emrys finds the Door's location — but the map redraws itself nightly, as if the world resists. Emotional beat: race against unraveling geography.

chapters.title: Bells Under the Ice
chapters.summary: Emrys's POV. They reach the frozen lake above the Door and hear Serevan's bells ringing beneath the ice. Emotional beat: hope, fragile as thin ice.

chapters.title: What Iri Is
chapters.summary: Iri's POV. Iri confesses: they are not a child but a vessel — the compiled memories of Serevan's children, given legs so someone could carry them home. Emotional beat: heartbreak and tenderness.

chapters.title: The Debt Comes Due
chapters.summary: Emrys's POV. Guild enforcers corner them on the ice; Emrys bargains with their own remaining memories as collateral to buy passage. Emotional beat: sacrifice as currency.

chapters.title: Halfway to No One
chapters.summary: Emrys's POV. To seal the bargain, Emrys surrenders a decade of memories — including, unknowingly, every moment spent with Iri. Emotional beat: devastating cost disguised as procedure.

chapters.title: Stranger Beside Me
chapters.summary: Iri's POV. Iri wakes to an Emrys who no longer remembers them, yet still chose to protect them on instinct alone. Emotional beat: love persisting without evidence.

chapters.title: The Hollow King Arrives
chapters.summary: Hollow King's POV. He reaches the lake, offering Emrys restoration of all memories in exchange for opening the Door to him alone. Emotional beat: seductive despair.

chapters.title: Two Kinds of Hunger
chapters.summary: Emrys's POV. Emrys sees the truth: the King wants the Door not to restore Serevan but to keep it hollow forever, a kingdom of preserved grief. Emotional beat: refusal born of clarity.

chapters.title: Ice Breaking
chapters.summary: Multiple POVs interwoven. Battle on the frozen lake as guild, Silent Court, and Emrys converge on the Door. Emotional beat: chaos with terrible momentum.

chapters.title: Through the Last Door
chapters.summary: Emrys's POV. Emrys and Iri fall through the Door into Serevan — intact, suspended in endless dusk, its people frozen mid-life. Emotional beat: homecoming as horror.

chapters.title: The Country That Waited
chapters.summary: Emrys's POV. Exploring paused Serevan, Emrys finds their childhood home and the record of their own sale. Emotional beat: rage crystallizing into purpose.

chapters.title: The Archive of Selves
chapters.summary: Emrys's POV. In Serevan's central archive, Emrys learns the erasure was a bargain: the guild bought the country's existence, one ledger entry at a time. Emotional beat: understanding the machinery of loss.

chapters.title: Corvane Inside
chapters.summary: Corvane's POV. Corvane enters Serevan with harvest crews, beginning to strip the frozen country bare. Emotional beat: plunder as piety.

chapters.title: Waking the Orchard
chapters.summary: Iri's POV. Iri begins releasing the children's memories back into Serevan's people, waking them one by one. Emotional beat: resurrection as slow labor.

chapters.title: The First to Wake
chapters.summary: New character POV: Maren, a Serevani baker, waking after thirty years to a stranger holding her daughter's memories. Emotional beat: disorientation turning to fierce gratitude.

chapters.title: The King's Claim
chapters.summary: Hollow King's POV. The King enters his restored kingdom and finds he cannot bear its joy — grief has become all he is. Emotional beat: tragedy of the antagonist.

chapters.title: Ledger Against Ledger
chapters.summary: Emrys's POV. Emrys confronts Corvane in the archive, fighting him with the guild's own instruments: forged entries, contested debts, a countersuit written in blood-ink. Emotional beat: clerical warfare, thrilling and absurd.

chapters.title: The Entry That Unmakes
chapters.summary: Emrys's POV. Emrys finds the original entry of their own sale and must decide whether to void it — which would erase everything since, including Iri. Emotional beat: impossible choice.

chapters.title: Winter Finishes Falling
chapters.summary: Multiple POVs. The long winter breaks over both worlds as the Door strains; the guild's harvest collapses; Corvane is consumed by the memories he stole. Emotional beat: reckoning.

chapters.title: Sef Oyelaran
chapters.summary: Emrys's POV. Emrys voids the sale, reclaiming their true name — and letting the borrowed life go, accepting they will not remember choosing this. Emotional beat: surrender as victory.

chapters.title: The Door Held Open
chapters.summary: Maren's POV. The Serevani pour through the Door into the outer world as winter ends; Maren carries Iri's sleeping form. Emotional beat: exodus, bittersweet and vast.

chapters.title: What the Guild Keeps
chapters.summary: Vesha's POV. Freed from the Silent Court, Vesha inherits the gutted guild and begins quietly returning stolen memories, keeping only one — hers. Emotional beat: imperfect redemption.

chapters.title: Spring Inventory
chapters.summary: Emrys/Sef's POV. Sef wakes in a small house above the old lake with no memory of the last year, holding a ledger page in their own handwriting: 'You chose this. Be kind to the child.' Emotional beat: gentle mystery.

chapters.title: The Child Who Waits
chapters.summary: Iri's POV. Iri, now aging into an ordinary girl as her cargo empties, introduces herself to Sef again. Emotional beat: beginnings without endings.

chapters.title: Hollow and Crown
chapters.summary: Sef's POV, closing frame. Sef takes work as a village record-keeper, writing down the arrivals' stories so no country can be unwritten again. Final image: two names in a fresh ledger — theirs, and Iri's. Emotional beat: earned peace, identity chosen rather than recovered.
